abstract: PURPOSE: To describe the imaging findings of germ cell tumours (GCT) containing non-germ cell malignant components (also designated teratoma with malignant transformation or TMT). PATIENTS AND METHODS: The records of 14 male patients with GCT and a non-germ cell histological component TMT were retrospectively reviewed. All patients had computed tomography (CT) and/or magnetic resonance (MR) studies before and after initial surgery and chemotherapy, as well as during follow-up. Imaging findings were correlated with the response to treatment and with overall survival. Pathological evaluation, immunohistochemistry, serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) were also taken into consideration. Sarcoma was identified in 10 out of 14 patients, with rhabdomyosarcoma ranking first (n=4), followed by osteosarcoma (n=2), fusiform cell sarcoma (n=1), undifferentiated sarcoma (n=1), neurosarcoma (n=1) and myxoid sarcoma (n=1). Other histological types of malignant transformation included adenocarcinoma (n=3) and bronchoalveolar carcinoma (n=1). Overall, 9 patients relapsed at a median time of 84 months (range 60-168). RESULTS: Non-GCT malignant transformation was identified in the retroperitoneum (5), testis (3), mediastinum (3), peritoneum (2) and lungs (1). The CT and MR imaging findings before treatment and after relapse were evaluated with emphasis on imaging features that could possibly imply the presence of malignant transformation (heterogeneously enhancing soft-tissue masses, ossified masses with calcified lymph nodes, diffuse epiploic thickening associated with ascites and peritoneal nodules, pulmonary alveolar infiltration with septal thickening). All but 1 patient with TMT presented with nodal and distant metastases. The prognosis was poor: within a median follow-up of 59 months (range 3-180), 4 out of 14 patients were alive. CONCLUSION: TMT is rare and associated with poorer survival compared to GCT. Imaging can be useful as CT and MR findings may suggest this entity and lead to an early biopsy and appropriate treatment.
abstract_ja:
目的：非胚細胞性悪性成分を含む胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)（奇形腫の悪性転化、すなわちTMTとも呼ばれる）の画像所見を記述すること。
患者と方法：非胚細胞性組織型成分TMTを伴うGCTを有する男性14例の診療録を後方視的に検討した。全例で初回手術および化学療法の前後、ならびにフォローアップ中にCTおよび/またはMRI検査が実施されていた。画像所見は治療反応および全生存期間と照合された。病理学的評価、免疫組織化学、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(HCG)も考慮された。14例中10例で肉腫が同定され、横紋筋肉腫が最も多く(4例)、続いて骨肉腫(2例)、紡錘形細胞肉腫(1例)、未分化肉腫(1例)、神経肉腫(1例)、粘液型肉腫(1例)であった。その他の悪性転化の組織型は腺癌(3例)、細気管支肺胞癌(1例)であった。全体で9例が再発し、再発までの中央値は84か月(範囲60～168)であった。
結果：非GCT性の悪性転化は、後腹膜(5例)、精巣(3例)、縦隔(3例)、腹膜(2例)、肺(1例)で同定された。治療前および再発後のCT・MRI所見を、悪性転化を示唆しうる画像的特徴に重点を置いて評価した（不均一に造影される軟部組織腫瘤、石灰化リンパ節を伴う骨化性腫瘤、腹水を伴うびまん性の大網肥厚と腹膜結節、中隔肥厚を伴う肺胞浸潤）。TMT症例のうち1例を除く全例に、リンパ節転移および遠隔転移がみられた。予後は不良で、追跡期間中央値59か月(範囲3～180)の時点で、14例中4例が生存していた。
結論：TMTはまれであり、GCTと比べて全生存期間が短い。CTおよびMRI所見はこの病態を示唆しうるため、早期生検と適切な治療につながる可能性があり、画像検査は有用である。
